BiblicalUsage: The word means to vomit, and its one use is the cup of God's wrath: drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the spuing as the body's answer to the cup, and the falling as the end of the nations that drink it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
